content: Poaron ehu ong Nanmwarki Ahas

Ni mwehin Nanmwarki Ahas, nein Sodam, Ahas pahpa kahlapki Usaia, mahwen ahpw wiawi. Resin, nanmwarki en Siria, oh Peka, nein Remalaia, nanmwarkien Israel, ira mahweniong Serusalem; ira ahpw sohte kak kalowehdi.
Ni nanmwarkien Suda eh karongehda me karis en Siria lelehr nan wehin Israel, ih oh sapwellime aramas koaros ahpw rerrerki ar masepwehkada, duwehte kisin tuhkehn nan kisinieng.
KAUN-O eri mahsanihong Aiseia, “Kohwei, kowe oh noumw pwutak Sear Sasup,
kumwa kohwei oh tuhwong Nanmwarki Ahas. Kumwa pahn tuhwong nanial wasa me sounwia likou kan kin doadoahk ie, ni imwin warawar me uhdihdo sang ni lehn poweo.

Ke ahpw ndaiong Ahas en mwasamwasahn, meleilei, oh en dehr masepwehk de nan kapehd tikitikla. Pwe engieng en Nanmwarki Resin oh mehn Siria kan, oh engieng en Nanmwarki Peka, sohte keper sang ediniei sang ni tuken tuhke riapwoat me ngkingken.
Pwe mehn Siria oh Israel, iangahki nanmwarkien Israel, irail inoukipene
pwe irail en kohla pelianda Suda oh kauwehla, oh itonehng mehn Suda kan re en iangirailla; re ahpw pahn kasapwilada nein Tapeel pwutako, pwe en wiahla nanmwarki.
“Ahpw ngehi, KAUN-O, mahsanih me met sohte pahn wiawi, e sohte pahn pweida;
pwe Siria kin koapworopworki Damaskus, oh Damaskus kin koapworopworki Nanmwarki Resin, ahpw nanmwarki Resin me luwet. Oh mwurin sounpar 65 Israel pahn mwomwla, sohla wia wehi ehu.
Pwe Israel kin koapworopworki kahnimw Sameria, oh Sameria kin koapworopworki Nanmwarki Peka, ahpw Nanmwarki Peka me luwet. “Ma kumwail sohte pahn pwoson, kumwail sohte pahn pweida.”
Kilel en Emanuel
KAUN-O ahpw pwurehng mahsanihong Ahas,
“Peki kilel ehu sang rehn KAUN-O omw Koht; mehnda ma sang wasa loal en wasahn me melahr akan de sang nanleng wasa ileilehie.”
Ahas ahpw sapeng, patohwan, “I sohte pahn peki. I sohte pahn kasongosonge KAUN-O.”

Aiseia eri patohwan, “Eri, kumwail kadaudok en Nanmwarki Depit, kumwail karonge mahs. Kumwail sohte itarki amwail katikitikihalahr en aramas akan ar kanengamah? Kumwail pil men kasongosonge sapwellimen Koht kanengamah?
Eri, pein Kaun-o pahn ketikihong kumwail ehu kilelen. Peinakapw
emen mie me liseiandahr. E pahn naitikihada nah pwutak emen, oh e pahn kamwarehki ‘Emanuel.’
Ni ahnsou me serio pahn esehla pein pilada dahme mwahu oh suwed, e pahn kin kangkang pwete oh sukehn loangalap.
Pwe mwohn ahnsou me serio pahn esehla pilada dahme mwahu oh suwed, sapwen nanmwarki riemeno me ke masak pahn tehnla.

“KAUN-O pahn ketikidohng pohmwail, oh pohn noumwail aramas akan, oh pohn peneinei en nanmwarkio, soangen rahn apwal ekei me suwed sang ni ahnsou me wehin Israel tohrohrala sang Suda—e pahn ketikihdo nanmwarkien Asiria!
“Ni ahnsowo, KAUN-O pahn ketin malipehdo mehn Isip kan, rasehng loahng kan sang nan kahng en pillap doh kan me kuspeneng nan Pillap Nail, oh mehn Asiria kan pahn kohdo rasehng loangalap akan.
Irail koaros pahn kohdo oh audehla nan wahu loal kan oh nan poaren paip kan, oh re pahn audehla wasa me tuhke tekatek kan mie oh nan sahpw mwahu kan.

“Ni ahnsowo, KAUN-O pahn ketin malipehdo sounseisei men sang palio Iupreitis, iei nanmwarkien Asiria, me pahn koakoahsang pitenmoangamwail oh wunen paliwaramwail, e pahn pil koakoahsang amwail alis kan.
“Ni ahnsowo, mehnda ma ohl emen pahn komourala koupwul tehmen oh kuht riemente,
uwen milik pwukat sang rehn mahn pwukat pahn itarohng eh anahn akan. Pwe koaros me pahn luhwehdi nan sahpwo pahn kin tungoale pwete oh sukehn loangalap.
Ni ahnsowo, mwetin wain kaselel kan, me ehuehu mwaht tuhkehn wain kid mi loale oh ehu mwetin wain konehng pweipweiki mwohni silper kid, pahn dipwidipwkihla tuhke tekatek oh dihpw suwed.
Aramas akan pahn kin kohla wasa pwuko, wa neirail kesik ketieu kan pwe re en kesik men. Eri, sahpwo pwon pahn diren dihpw suwed oh tekatek.

Dohl koaros me wahnsahpw akan poadidier ie mahs pahn dipwidipwkihla tuhke tekatek kahrehda sohla me pahn kohla wasa pwuko. Wasa pwukat pahn wiahla en kou kan wasahn mwenge, oh en sihpw kan wasahn kohkohseli.”
